original_quote: Any one of them could make you a billionaire. 1. A new search engine. 2. Replace email. 3. Replace universities. 4. Internet drama. 5. The next Steve Jobs. 6. Bring back Moore's Law. 7. Ongoing diagnosis.
why_resurface: PG named seven billion-dollar bets in 2012 and never updated which came true, which failed, or what the next seven would be — a decade+ scorecard is overdue.

original_quote: I think VC funds are seriously threatened by the super-angels. Those who raise VC rounds will get higher valuations because of leverage from postponed dilution.
why_resurface: PG predicted super-angels would threaten traditional VCs in 2010, then the mega-fund era exploded — he never reconciled whether his thesis held or inverted.

original_quote: Java will turn out to be an evolutionary dead-end, like Cobol.
why_resurface: PG's boldest language prediction — that Java would become Cobol — went unaddressed for 14 years while Java remained dominant in mobile and enterprise.
